title: Razkadr run manifest
description: RunContext output (naryad 036): run metadata, stage log, provider call accounting and the final summary (naryad 011). See docs/artifacts.md.

run_id.description: Run identifier; equals the run directory name.

created_utc.description: Run start time, UTC; ISO 8601 (syntactic check: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss[.frac](Z|±hh:mm)).

razkadr_version.description: Version of the razkadr package that produced the run.

config_hash.description: sha256 of the effective run configuration; changes when presets/providers change.

tool_versions.description: Versions of external tools used by the run (ffmpeg, python, ...).

stages.description: One entry per executed stage, in execution order.

name.description: Stage name (ingest, frames, transcript, chunks, ocr, index, select, text, build).

started_utc.description: Stage start time, UTC; ISO 8601 (syntactic check: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss[.frac](Z|±hh:mm)).

error.description: Failure reason; present when status is failed.

provider_calls.description: Accounting of external API calls; empty for CPU-only runs.

stage.description: Pipeline stage that made the call.

provider.description: Provider id from the provider layer.

task.description: Provider task type; useful when one provider serves several tasks.

units.description: Billed or measured units of the call (seconds of audio, tokens, images).

tariff_date.description: Date of the provider tariff; ISO 8601 calendar date (syntactic check).

cache_hit.description: True when the result came from the call cache and no billable request was made.

summary.description: Final run summary (naryad 011), written once by the command when every stage has finished: per-stage wall time, aggregated provider cost and key artifact counts. Absent while stages are running or after a failed run.

stage_times_s.description: Wall time per stage, seconds; the last completed attempt of each stage in this run (failed attempts without a duration are not counted).

provider_cost.description: provider_calls aggregated: total cost, per-stage cost, call and cache-hit counts.

amount.description: Total cost across all provider calls of the run.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of every call; absent when there were no calls.

cache_hits.description: Calls served from the call cache.

artifacts.description: Key numbers from the run artifacts: frames_candidates, frames_accepted, frames_rejected, ocr_results, ocr_frames_sent, transcript_segments, transcript_s (speech seconds covered by segments), chunks, index_vectors.

schemaVersion.description: Artifact schema version, semver (patch may be omitted).
